107895.name: Mgat5
107895.summary: Enables alpha-1,6-mannosylglycoprotein 6-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity. Acts upstream of or within protein N-linked glycosylation. Located in Golgi apparatus. Is expressed in several structures, including alimentary system; brain; integumental system; sensory organ; and urinary system. Orthologous to human MGAT5 (alpha-1,6-mannosylglycoprotein 6-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

110265.name: Msra
110265.otherdesignations: mitochondrial peptide methionine sulfoxide reductase|PMSR|peptide Met(O) reductase|peptide methionine sulfoxide reductase|peptide-methionine (S)-S-oxide reductase|protein-methionine-S-oxide reductase
110265.summary: Enables peptide-methionine (S)-S-oxide reductase activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to oxidative stress. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including musculoskeletal system; nervous system; respiratory system; sensory organ; and testis. Orthologous to human MSRA (methionine sulfoxide reductase A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

114774.name: Pawr
114774.otherdesignations: PRKC apoptosis WT1 regulator protein|PRKC, apoptosis, WT1, regulator|prostate apoptosis response 4 protein
114774.summary: Predicted to enable actin binding activity; enzyme binding activity; and leucine zipper domain binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of cellular senescence; positive regulation of hydrogen peroxide-mediated programmed cell death; and regulation of gene expression. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including negative regulation of T cell receptor signaling pathway; negative regulation of lymphocyte proliferation; and positive regulation of amyloid precursor protein biosynthetic process. Located in chromatin; cytoplasm; and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including alimentary system; brain; genitourinary system; hemolymphoid system; and respiratory system. Orthologous to human PAWR (pro-apoptotic WT1 regulator). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

117353.name: Pcyt1
117353.otheraliases: Dmel_CG1049, CCT1, CG1049, CT41283, Cct, Cct1, Dmel\CG1049, cct1, pcyt1
117353.otherdesignations: phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase 1|CG1049-PA|CG1049-PB|CG1049-PC|CG1049-PD|CG1049-PE|CG1049-PF|CTP-phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase|CTP:phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase|CTP:phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase 1|Pcyt1-PA|Pcyt1-PB|Pcyt1-PC|Pcyt1-PD|Pcyt1-PE|Pcyt1-PF|cytidylyltransferase 1|phosphocholine cytidylyltransferase
117353.summary: Enables choline-phosphate cytidylyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; establishment of ommatidial planar polarity; and imaginal disc-derived wing morphogenesis. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; amnioserosa primordium; anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; and epithelium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital generalized lipodystrophy and spondylometaphyseal dysplasia with cone-rod dystrophy. Orthologous to human PCYT1A (phosphate cytidylyltransferase 1A, choline). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171593.name: sesn-1
171593.summary: Predicted to enable L-leucine binding activity and oxidoreductase activity, acting on peroxide as acceptor. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cellular response to L-leucine; cellular response to leucine starvation; and negative regulation of TORC1 signaling. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including SESN1 (sestrin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171602.name: rpl-7
171602.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in germ line and somatic cell. Orthologous to human RPL7 (ribosomal protein L7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171622.name: nol-14
171622.summary: Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA. Predicted to be located in nucleolus. Predicted to be part of Noc4p-Nop14p complex and small-subunit processome. Orthologous to human NOP14 (NOP14 nucleolar protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171646.name: icd-2
171646.summary: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein targeting to membrane. Predicted to be part of nascent polypeptide-associated complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in intestinal cell and muscle cell. Orthologous to several human genes including NACA4P (NACA family member 4, pseudogene). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171647.name: wwp-1
171647.summary: Enables ubiquitin conjugating enzyme activity. Involved in defense response to bacterium; protein ubiquitination; and regulation of protein catabolic process. Acts upstream of or within determination of adult lifespan. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including coelomocyte; intestine; nervous system; rectum; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to several human genes including WWP1 (WW domain containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171654.name: vps-20
171654.summary: Predicted to be involved in late endosome to vacuole transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway; nuclear membrane reassembly; and vesicle budding from membrane. Predicted to be located in endosome membrane. Predicted to be part of ESCRT III complex. Predicted to be active in multivesicular body and nuclear envelope. Orthologous to human CHMP6 (charged multivesicular body protein 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171670.name: zfh-2
171670.description: Zinc Finger and Homeobox;Zinc finger homeobox protein 4;Zinc finger protein
171670.otherdesignations: Zinc Finger and Homeobox;Zinc finger homeobox protein 4;Zinc finger protein
171670.nomenclaturename: Zinc Finger and Homeobox;Zinc finger homeobox protein 4;Zinc finger protein
171670.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in insulin-like growth factor receptor signaling pathway; negative regulation of gene expression; and negative regulation of lipid storage. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in body wall musculature; enteric muscle; nerve ring; neurons; and vulval muscle. Used to study obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Marsili syndrome; familial atrial fibrillation; hepatocellular carcinoma; lung non-small cell carcinoma (multiple); and spinocerebellar ataxia 4. Orthologous to several human genes including ZFHX3 (zinc finger homeobox 3) and ZFHX4 (zinc finger homeobox 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171687.name: gsa-1
171687.description: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(s) subunit alpha
171687.otherdesignations: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(s) subunit alpha
171687.nomenclaturename: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(s) subunit alpha
171687.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including nematode pharyngeal pumping; oocyte growth; and positive regulation of oocyte maturation. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be part of heterotrimeric G-protein complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory cell; intestine; neurons; non-striated muscle; and somatic nervous system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including ACTH-independent macronodular adrenal hyperplasia 1; McCune Albright syndrome; dystonia 25; pituitary adenoma 3; and pseudohypoparathyroidism (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including GNAL (G protein subunit alpha L). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171691.name: aps-3
171691.description: AP complex mu/sigma subunit domain-containing protein
171691.otherdesignations: AP complex mu/sigma subunit domain-containing protein
171691.nomenclaturename: AP complex mu/sigma subunit domain-containing protein
171691.summary: Predicted to be involved in vesicle-mediated transport. Predicted to be located in Golgi apparatus and cytoplasmic vesicle membrane. Predicted to be part of AP-3 adaptor complex. Orthologous to human AP3S1 (adaptor related protein complex 3 subunit sigma 1) and AP3S2 (adaptor related protein complex 3 subunit sigma 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171692.name: rpl-17
171692.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Predicted to be located in cytosolic ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; intestine; nervous system; non-striated muscle; and pharynx. Orthologous to human RPL17 (ribosomal protein L17). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171735.name: atg-5
171735.summary: Predicted to contribute to Atg8-family ligase activity. Involved in autophagosome assembly and regulation of autophagy. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 complex. Predicted to be active in autophagosome; phagophore; and phagophore assembly site membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 25. Orthologous to human ATG5 (autophagy related 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171739.name: lin-65
171739.description: ML domain-containing protein;RING-type domain-containing protein;uncharacterized protein
171739.otherdesignations: ML domain-containing protein;RING-type domain-containing protein;uncharacterized protein
171739.nomenclaturename: ML domain-containing protein;RING-type domain-containing protein;uncharacterized protein
171739.summary: Involved in chromatin remodeling and mitochondrial unfolded protein response. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in head neurons and intestine. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171746.name: pghm-1
171746.summary: Predicted to enable copper ion binding activity and peptidylglycine monooxygenase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptide metabolic process. Predicted to be located in extracellular region and membrane. Is expressed in head ganglion; nervous system; and tail ganglion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171751.name: egl-30
171751.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to dopamine; positive regulation of protein localization; and regulation of secretion. Located in axon; cell cortex; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in several structures, including neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Sturge-Weber syndrome; autosomal dominant hypocalcemia 2; congestive heart failure; familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia 2; and familial multiple nevi flammei. Orthologous to several human genes including GNA11 (G protein subunit alpha 11) and GNAQ (G protein subunit alpha q). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171768.name: phb-1
171768.summary: Involved in several processes, including defecation; regulation of nematode pharyngeal pumping; and regulation of oxidative phosphorylation. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of mitochondrial prohibitin complex. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; excretory canal; hypodermis; intestine; and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer and sporadic breast cancer. Orthologous to human PHB1 (prohibitin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171778.name: ule-1
171778.summary: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in eggshell formation. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Predicted to be active in external encapsulating structure. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171784.name: cdk-7
171784.summary: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat kinase activity and cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in mRNA transcription and mitotic cell cycle, embryonic. Predicted to be part of transcription factor TFIIK complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human CDK7 (cyclin dependent kinase 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171792.name: eif-2gamma
171792.summary: Predicted to enable translation initiation factor activity. Predicted to contribute to tRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in formation of translation preinitiation complex. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 complex. Is expressed in several structures, including enteric muscle; nervous system; pharynx; reproductive system; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in MEHMO syndrome. Orthologous to human EIF2S3 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 subunit gamma) and EIF2S3B (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 subunit gamma B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171797.name: dot-1.1
171797.summary: Predicted to enable histone H3K79 methyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA damage checkpoint signaling; DNA repair; and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Predicted to be located in chromosome. Predicted to be part of histone methyltransferase complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed widely. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Nil-Deshwar neurodevelopmental syndrome and acute biphenotypic leukemia. Orthologous to human DOT1L (DOT1 like histone lysine methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171853.name: rpl-10a
171853.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL10A (ribosomal protein L10a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171872.name: mek-2
171872.description: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase mek-2
171872.otherdesignations: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase mek-2
171872.nomenclaturename: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase mek-2
171872.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine/tyrosine kinase activity and scaffold protein binding activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-positive bacterium; intracellular signaling cassette; and vulval development. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in carcinoma (multiple); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome 3; cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome 4; high grade glioma; and melorheostosis. Orthologous to human MAP2K1 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1) and MAP2K2 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171874.name: nobh-1
171874.summary: Predicted to enable RNA endonuclease activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in neurons. Orthologous to human NOB1 (NIN1 (RPN12) binding protein 1 homolog). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171879.name: mod-5
171879.summary: Enables serotonin:sodium:chloride symporter activity. Involved in serotonin uptake. Predicted to be located in membrane and presynapse. Predicted to be active in neuron projection; plasma membrane; and synapse. Is expressed in several structures, including nerve ring. Used to study cocaine abuse. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcohol dependence; anxiety disorder (multiple); depressive disorder (multiple); heart disease (multiple); and substance abuse (multiple). Orthologous to human SLC6A4 (solute carrier family 6 member 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171901.name: nol-58
171901.summary: Predicted to enable snoRNA binding activity. Predicted to be located in nucleolus. Predicted to be part of box C/D methylation guide snoRNP complex and small-subunit processome. Orthologous to human NOP58 (NOP58 ribonucleoprotein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171915.name: spg-7
171915.summary: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; mitochondrial protein processing; and positive regulation of nematode male tail tip morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be part of m-AAA complex. Is expressed in germ line. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in optic atrophy 12; spastic ataxia; spastic ataxia 5; and spinocerebellar ataxia 28. Orthologous to human AFG3L2 (AFG3 like matrix AAA peptidase subunit 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

171919.name: Y47G6A.18
171919.summary: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in Golgi organization and Golgi vesicle transport. Predicted to be located in Golgi membrane. Predicted to be active in Golgi cisterna; cytosol; and trans-Golgi network. Orthologous to several human genes including GOLPH3 (golgi phosphoprotein 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171939.name: hus-1
171939.summary: Involved in several processes, including DNA metabolic process; determination of adult lifespan; and intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in response to DNA damage. Located in chromatin and germ cell nucleus. Is expressed in germ line. Orthologous to several human genes including HUS1 (HUS1 checkpoint clamp component). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

171986.name: cpn-3
171986.summary: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity. Predicted to be involved in actin filament organization. Located in myofibril. Is expressed in anal region; body wall musculature; egg-laying apparatus; enteric muscle; and head neurons. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172011.name: suco-1
172011.summary: Predicted to be located in endomembrane system. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and membrane. Is expressed widely. Orthologous to human SUCO (SUN domain containing ossification factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172035.name: pdp-1
172035.summary: Predicted to enable [pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring)]-phosphatase activity. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in head muscle; head neurons; intestine; and tail neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in obesity and pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency. Orthologous to human PDP1 (pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphatase catalytic subunit 1) and PDP2 (pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphatase catalytic subunit 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172037.name: lpd-5
172037.summary: Involved in lipid storage. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Used to study mitochondrial metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leigh disease and nuclear type mitochondrial complex I deficiency 1. Orthologous to human NDUFS4 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit S4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172051.name: gcy-28
172051.summary: Enables guanylate cyclase activity. Involved in several processes, including olfactory behavior; sensory perception of chemical stimulus; and sensory processing. Located in cell body and neuron projection. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; hypodermis; intestine; neurons; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Miura type epiphyseal chondrodysplasia; acromesomelic dysplasia, Maroteaux type; essential hypertension; and myocardial infarction. Orthologous to several human genes including NPR1 (natriuretic peptide receptor 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172054.name: bet-1
172054.summary: Enables SUMO binding activity and histone H4 reader activity. Involved in several processes, including multicellular organismal locomotion; muscle cell cellular homeostasis; and regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Located in chromosome; metaphase plate; and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; hypodermis; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Cornelia de Lange syndrome 6; idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; lymphoma (multiple); male infertility (multiple); and photosensitivity disease. Orthologous to several human genes including BRD2 (bromodomain containing 2) and BRDT (bromodomain testis associated). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172061.name: rps-10
172061.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 9. Orthologous to human RPS10 (ribosomal protein S10) and RPS10P5 (ribosomal protein S10 pseudogene 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172074.name: rpl-4
172074.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL4 (ribosomal protein L4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172088.name: let-502
172088.summary: Predicted to enable Rho-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including embryonic body morphogenesis; nematode pharyngeal gland morphogenesis; and nematode pharynx development. Located in adherens junction; contractile muscle fiber; and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; P4.p hermaphrodite; hypodermis; reproductive system; and tail. Orthologous to human ROCK1 (Rho associated coiled-coil containing protein kinase 1) and ROCK2 (Rho associated coiled-coil containing protein kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172099.name: htp-3
172099.summary: Involved in homologous chromosome pairing at meiosis and meiotic DNA double-strand break formation. Located in chromatin and lateral element. Is expressed in Z2; Z3; embryonic cell; germ line; and neurons. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172111.name: mfsd-13.1
172111.description: Major Facilitator Superfamily Domain containing homolog
172111.otherdesignations: Major Facilitator Superfamily Domain containing homolog
172111.nomenclaturename: Major Facilitator Superfamily Domain containing homolog
172111.summary: Orthologous to human SLC68A1 (solute carrier family 68 member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172127.name: pat-10
172127.summary: Enables troponin I binding activity. Involved in embryo development; muscle contraction; and skeletal muscle thin filament assembly. Located in contractile muscle fiber. Is expressed in body wall musculature; gonadal sheath cell; rectal muscle; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to human CALML6 (calmodulin like 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172137.name: spe-5
172137.summary: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity and proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in intracellular pH reduction; positive regulation of programmed cell death; and spermatocyte division. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in sperm and spermatocyte. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant congenital deafness with onychodystrophy and renal tubular acidosis. Orthologous to human ATP6V1B1 (ATPase H+ transporting V1 subunit B1) and ATP6V1B2 (ATPase H+ transporting V1 subunit B2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172153.name: let-630
172153.summary: Predicted to enable rRNA binding activity and ribosomal small subunit binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 51. Orthologous to human PTCD3 (pentatricopeptide repeat domain 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172164.name: mrpl-47
172164.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial ribosome. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL47 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L47). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172167.name: let-363
172167.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including TOR signaling; box C/D snoRNP assembly; and determination of adult lifespan. Located in cytoplasm. Part of TORC1 complex and TORC2 complex. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; muscle cell; neurons; pharynx; and vulva. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease; kidney angiomyolipoma; lung disease (multiple); prostate cancer; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human MTOR (mechanistic target of rapamycin kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172174.name: erm-1
172174.summary: Enables cytoskeletal anchor activity. Involved in several processes, including actin filament organization; nematode larval development; and protein localization to basolateral plasma membrane. Located in several cellular components, including actin filament; apical cortex; and apical plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anal sphincter muscle; excretory cell; intestine; nervous system; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 24 and immunodeficiency 50. Orthologous to several human genes including EZR (ezrin) and RDX (radixin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172195.name: atp-3
172195.summary: Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and proton motive force-driven mitochondrial ATP synthesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 7. Orthologous to human ATP5PO (ATP synthase peripheral stalk subunit OSCP). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172201.name: rpl-19
172201.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; excretory cell; nervous system; pharynx; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to human RPL19 (ribosomal protein L19). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172204.name: mrpl-24
172204.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human MRPL24 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L24). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172209.name: tom-1
172209.description: Lethal giant larvae homologue 2 domain-containing protein;V-SNARE coiled-coil homology domain-containing protein
172209.otherdesignations: Lethal giant larvae homologue 2 domain-containing protein;V-SNARE coiled-coil homology domain-containing protein
172209.nomenclaturename: Lethal giant larvae homologue 2 domain-containing protein;V-SNARE coiled-coil homology domain-containing protein
172209.summary: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity and myosin II binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to salt; regulation of presynaptic dense core granule exocytosis; and regulation of synaptic vesicle docking. Is active in GABA-ergic synapse; cholinergic synapse; and neuromuscular junction. Is extrinsic component of neuronal dense core vesicle membrane. Is expressed in head neurons; tail neurons; and ventral cord neurons. Orthologous to several human genes including STXBP5 (syntaxin binding protein 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172231.name: dnj-21
172231.description: Mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM14
172231.otherdesignations: Mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM14
172231.nomenclaturename: Mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM14
172231.summary: Predicted to enable ATPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into mitochondrial matrix. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in 3-methylglutaconic aciduria type 5. Orthologous to several human genes including DNAJC19 (DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member C19). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172302.name: tin-44
172302.description: putative mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit tin-44
172302.otherdesignations: putative mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit tin-44
172302.nomenclaturename: putative mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit tin-44
172302.summary: Predicted to enable protein-folding chaperone binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into mitochondrial matrix. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of PAM complex, Tim23 associated import motor. Is expressed in intestine; nervous system; pharynx; reproductive system; and tail. Orthologous to human TIMM44 (translocase of inner mitochondrial membrane 44). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172303.name: chn-1
172303.summary: Enables Hsp70 protein binding activity; ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity; and ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity. Involved in several processes, including egg-laying behavior; protein ubiquitination; and sarcomere organization. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including copulatory spicule; germ line; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; nervous system; and pharynx. Used to study Duchenne muscular dystrophy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 16 and cerebellar ataxia type 48. Orthologous to human STUB1 (STIP1 homology and U-box containing protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172321.name: let-611
172321.description: DNA-directed RNA polymerase III subunit RPC3
172321.otherdesignations: DNA-directed RNA polymerase III subunit RPC3
172321.nomenclaturename: DNA-directed RNA polymerase III subunit RPC3
172321.summary: Predicted to enable single-stranded DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in termination of RNA polymerase III transcription and transcription initiation at RNA polymerase III promoter. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of RNA polymerase III complex. Orthologous to human POLR3C (RNA polymerase III subunit C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172327.name: pnk-1
172327.summary: Predicted to enable phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in coenzyme A biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cataract and pantothenate kinase-associated neurodegeneration. Orthologous to several human genes including PANK1 (pantothenate kinase 1); PANK2 (pantothenate kinase 2); and PANK3 (pantothenate kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172353.name: cdc-25.1
172353.summary: Predicted to enable protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. Involved in meiotic spindle organization and positive regulation of mitotic cell cycle. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including Z2; Z3; germ line; oocyte; and sperm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cervical cancer; endometrial cancer; prostate cancer; and urinary bladder cancer. Orthologous to human CDC25A (cell division cycle 25A); CDC25B (cell division cycle 25B); and CDC25C (cell division cycle 25C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172363.name: nuo-2
172363.summary: Predicted to enable NADH dehydrogenase (ubiquinone) activity and oxidoreductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in reproductive system; seam cell; and spermatheca. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nuclear type mitochondrial complex I deficiency 8. Orthologous to human NDUFS3 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase core subunit S3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172376.name: ipgm-1
172376.summary: Enables phosphoglycerate mutase activity. Involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in body wall musculature; intestine; and nerve ring. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172390.name: lbp-6
172390.summary: Predicted to enable fatty acid binding activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty acid transport. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to several human genes including FABP3 (fatty acid binding protein 3); FABP4 (fatty acid binding protein 4); and FABP7 (fatty acid binding protein 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172418.name: smg-1
172418.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in male genitalia development and nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, nonsense-mediated decay. Predicted to be part of TOR complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human SMG1 (SMG1 nonsense mediated mRNA decay associated PI3K related kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172438.name: nuo-6
172438.summary: Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Is expressed in body wall musculature; germ line; gonad; hypodermis; and intestine. Orthologous to human NDUFB4 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit B4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172442.name: nars-1
172442.summary: Predicted to enable asparagine-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in translation. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human NARS1 (asparaginyl-tRNA synthetase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172460.name: nhr-23
172460.description: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-23
172460.otherdesignations: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-23
172460.nomenclaturename: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-23
172460.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and spermatogenesis. Acts upstream of or within positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in chromatin and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad; hypodermis; oocyte; spermatocyte; and vulva. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in allergic rhinitis; chronic asthma (multiple); immunodeficiency 42; and lung disease (multiple). Orthologous to human RORA (RAR related orphan receptor A); RORB (RAR related orphan receptor B); and RORC (RAR related orphan receptor C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172478.name: F13G3.7
172478.summary: Predicted to enable branched-chain amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in branched-chain amino acid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human SLC25A44 (solute carrier family 25 member 44). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172488.name: inx-14
172488.summary: Predicted to enable gap junction hemi-channel activity. Acts upstream of or within with a positive effect on germ cell proliferation. Acts upstream of or within with a negative effect on oocyte maturation. Is active in gap junction. Is expressed in several structures, including GABAergic neurons; germ cell; germ line; non-striated muscle; and somatic gonad precursor. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172497.name: unc-13
172497.description: Phorbol ester/diacylglycerol-binding protein unc-13;Protein kinase C
172497.otherdesignations: Phorbol ester/diacylglycerol-binding protein unc-13;Protein kinase C
172497.nomenclaturename: Phorbol ester/diacylglycerol-binding protein unc-13;Protein kinase C
172497.summary: Predicted to enable calmodulin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of oocyte development; regulation of egg-laying behavior; and regulation of nematode pharyngeal pumping. Located in presynaptic active zone. Is expressed in nervous system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Orthologous to human UNC13A (unc-13 homolog A); UNC13B (unc-13 homolog B); and UNC13C (unc-13 homolog C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172499.name: lars-2
172499.summary: Predicted to enable leucine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in leucyl-tRNA aminoacylation and mitochondrial translation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in body wall musculature; intestine; and neurons. Used to study Perrault syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Perrault syndrome. Orthologous to human LARS2 (leucyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172505.name: goa-1
172505.description: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(o) subunit alpha
172505.otherdesignations: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(o) subunit alpha
172505.nomenclaturename: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(o) subunit alpha
172505.summary: Enables several functions, including G protein activity; G protein-coupled acetylcholine receptor activity; and GTP binding activity. Involved in several processes, including detection of cold stimulus involved in thermoception; negative regulation of cholinergic synaptic transmission; and response to serotonin. Located in cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including neurons; non-striated muscle; pharynx; spermatheca; and vulva. Used to study developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 17; and early infantile epileptic encephalopathy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 17 and neurodevelopmental disorder with involuntary movements. Orthologous to human GNAO1 (G protein subunit alpha o1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172510.name: mans-1
172510.summary: Predicted to enable mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,2-alpha-mannosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in ERAD pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in Golgi membrane and endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to several human genes including MAN1A1 (mannosidase alpha class 1A member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172513.name: ndub-7
172513.summary: Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane and mitochondrial intermembrane space. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nuclear type mitochondrial complex I deficiency. Orthologous to human NDUFB7 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit B7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172518.name: wdr-23
172518.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; negative regulation of cellular response to manganese ion; and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including hermaphrodite gonad; hypodermis; intestine; muscle cell; and nervous system. Orthologous to human DCAF11 (DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172525.name: F26A3.4
172525.summary: Located in striated muscle dense body. Is expressed in neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pulmonary tuberculosis. Orthologous to human DUSP14 (dual specificity phosphatase 14). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172542.name: adr-1
172542.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including adenosine to inosine editing; determination of adult lifespan; and regulation of vulval development. Located in cytosolic ribosome and nucleus. Is expressed in body wall musculature; intestine; nervous system; and vulva. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172556.name: pck-2
172556.summary: Predicted to enable manganese ion binding activity and phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (GTP) activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including carbohydrate biosynthetic process; cellular response to glucose stimulus; and oxaloacetate metabolic process. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; intestine; muscle cell; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to several human genes including PCK1 (phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172582.name: cyc-1
172582.summary: Predicted to enable electron transfer activity and heme binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and proton motive force-driven mitochondrial ATP synthesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex III. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 6. Orthologous to human CYC1 (cytochrome c1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172584.name: eif-2beta
172584.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity; translation initiation factor activity; and translation initiation factor binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; regulation of growth; and translation. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 complex. Orthologous to human EIF2S2 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 subunit beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172593.name: che-3
172593.summary: Predicted to enable dynein intermediate chain binding activity; dynein light intermediate chain binding activity; and minus-end-directed microtubule motor activity. Involved in several processes, including dauer entry; non-motile cilium assembly; and positive regulation of dauer larval development. Located in non-motile cilium. Is expressed in I4 neuron; ciliated neurons; and nerve ring. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in asphyxiating thoracic dystrophy and asphyxiating thoracic dystrophy 3. Orthologous to human DYNC2H1 (dynein cytoplasmic 2 heavy chain 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172600.name: ins-18
172600.summary: Involved in maintenance of dauer; negative regulation of insulin receptor signaling pathway; and regulation of dauer entry. Is expressed in several structures, including coelomocyte; gonad; head muscle; neurons; and somatic nervous system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172611.name: npp-2
172611.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of nuclear pore. Involved in several processes, including nucleus organization; protein localization to kinetochore; and protein localization to nuclear envelope. Part of nuclear pore. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nephrotic syndrome type 17. Orthologous to human NUP85 (nucleoporin 85). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172616.name: cep-1
172616.summary: Enables several functions, including DNA-binding transcription factor activity; protein homodimerization activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; intracellular signal transduction; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleolus and nucleoplasm. Is active in nucleus. Is expressed in Z2; Z3; germ line; pharyngeal cell; and pharynx. Used to study cancer. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172626.name: lin-28
172626.summary: Enables RNA binding activity and enzyme binding activity. Involved in several processes, including regulation of cell fate specification; regulation of development, heterochronic; and regulation of gene expression. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; nervous system; pharynx; reproductive system; and somatic gonad precursor. Orthologous to human LIN28A (lin-28 RNA binding posttranscriptional regulator A) and LIN28B (lin-28 RNA binding posttranscriptional regulator B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172632.name: sod-2
172632.summary: Enables superoxide dismutase activity. Involved in removal of superoxide radicals. Located in mitochondrion. Part of respiratory chain complex. Is expressed in head and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including artery disease (multiple); autoimmune disease of musculoskeletal system (multiple); diabetes mellitus (multiple); liver disease (multiple); and optic nerve disease (multiple). Orthologous to human SOD2 (superoxide dismutase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172645.name: gpa-15
172645.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Located in non-motile cilium. Is expressed in chemosensory neurons and hermaphrodite somatic gonadal cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172655.name: idha-1
172655.summary: Predicted to enable isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in protein folding. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including hypodermis; intestinal muscle; intestine; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 90. Orthologous to human IDH3A (isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD(+)) 3 catalytic subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172673.name: asg-1
172673.description: putative ATP synthase subunit g 1, mitochondrial
172673.otherdesignations: putative ATP synthase subunit g 1, mitochondrial
172673.nomenclaturename: putative ATP synthase subunit g 1, mitochondrial
172673.summary: Predicted to enable proton transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial membrane. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP5MG (ATP synthase membrane subunit g). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172676.name: tlf-1
172676.summary: Predicted to enable general transcription initiation factor activity. Involved in embryo development; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in chromatin and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line. Orthologous to human TBPL1 (TATA-box binding protein like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172687.name: lmn-1
172687.summary: Enables histone binding activity; identical protein binding activity; and structural molecule activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; nuclear migration along microtubule; and nuclear pore localization. Located in nuclear envelope and nuclear periphery. Is expressed in several structures, including ventral cord blast cell. Used to study Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy; congenital muscular dystrophy; muscular dystrophy; and progeria. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autosomal dominant primary microcephaly (multiple); intrinsic cardiomyopathy (multiple); lipodystrophy (multiple); muscular dystrophy (multiple); and type 2 diabetes mellitus (multiple). Orthologous to human LMNA (lamin A/C); LMNB1 (lamin B1); and LMNB2 (lamin B2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172692.name: F36A2.7
172692.summary: Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; pharynx; and spermatheca. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172693.name: rps-15
172693.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS15 (ribosomal protein S15). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172743.name: eef-2
172743.summary: Predicted to enable GTPase activity; ribosome binding activity; and translation elongation factor activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium and negative regulation of gene expression. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of ribonucleoprotein complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glaucoma; spinocerebellar ataxia 26; and stomach cancer. Orthologous to human EEF2 (eukaryotic translation elongation factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172752.name: rpoa-2
172752.description: DNA-directed RNA polymerase I subunit RPA2 homolog
172752.otherdesignations: DNA-directed RNA polymerase I subunit RPA2 homolog
172752.nomenclaturename: DNA-directed RNA polymerase I subunit RPA2 homolog
172752.summary: Predicted to enable 5'-3' RNA polymerase activity; DNA binding activity; and ribonucleoside binding activity. Predicted to contribute to DNA-directed RNA polymerase activity. Predicted to be involved in transcription elongation by RNA polymerase I. Located in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; pharynx; and rectal gland cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Treacher Collins syndrome 4. Orthologous to human POLR1B (RNA polymerase I subunit B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172755.name: rab-5
172755.summary: Enables GTPase activating protein binding activity and GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including apical protein localization; endocytosis; and secretion by cell. Located in cell cortex; cytoplasmic vesicle; and periciliary membrane compartment. Is active in cholinergic synapse. Is expressed in several structures, including ventral cord neurons. Orthologous to several human genes including RAB5C (RAB5C, member RAS oncogene family). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172771.name: mec-8
172771.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including hemidesmosome assembly; mechanosensory behavior; and nematode larval development. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including head muscle; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and vulva. Orthologous to human RBPMS (RNA binding protein, mRNA processing factor) and RBPMS2 (RNA binding protein, mRNA processing factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172773.name: skr-2
172773.summary: Predicted to enable cullin family protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; negative regulation of centrosome duplication; and regulation of protein stability. Part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in intestine. Orthologous to human SKP1 (S-phase kinase associated protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172775.name: skr-1
172775.summary: Predicted to enable cullin family protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of centrosome duplication; negative regulation of intracellular signal transduction; and regulation of synapse pruning. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; neurons; pharynx; and spermatheca. Orthologous to human SKP1 (S-phase kinase associated protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172778.name: sacm-1L
172778.summary: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in intestine; pharyngeal neurons; pharynx; spermatheca; and tail. Orthologous to human SACM1L (SAC1 like phosphatidylinositide phosphatase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172782.name: usp-48
172782.summary: Predicted to enable cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of protein stability. Predicted to be located in chromosome. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed widely. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 85. Orthologous to human USP48 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 48). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
